description:
Coverage-only, planning first; no production code, fixtures outside the exclusive path, migration, tool/Action, UI, or documentation edit. Exclusive test file to EDIT: test/zaq/people/identity_resolver_test.exs. Scope: lib/zaq/people/identity_resolver.ex lines 81,82,86,104,127,152,234,245,305. The existing DataCase module is async: true and uses sandboxed Repo, incoming/1, complete_person_with_channel/2, person_email_channel/2, ErrorRouter and RaiseRouter. Reuse them and public IdentityResolver.resolve/2 and resolve_audience/2; no private calls. Existing audience tests already prove active/dedup, mismatch, malformed sender, empty recipients and disabled connector. Preserve those assertions. Consult AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/services/engine.md and docs/services/bo-auth.md. BO auth is contextual: no BO authorization/UI/API changes. Engine identity rules require connector scope and no automatic cross-owner reassignment. Action reuse: not applicable—only exercising existing public operations, no executable operation altered or added. No E2E/UX approval needed for DB-backed resolver regression testing; no docs updates unless behavior differs from stated contract, in which case raise separate issue instead of silently changing semantics.

Tests to add before any implementation, all in that one file:
1. Line 81 (inactive recipient): build enabled real retrieval IMAP config using the existing ChannelConfig.changeset/Repo.insert! pattern and an Incoming with author_id = audience.sender, config ID matched, platform = email. Create two recipients via person_email_channel/2, set one Person status to "inactive" via People.update_person/2 or Person.update_changeset + Repo.update! (check effect on channel persistence); assert resolve_audience returns only active ID and remains sorted, while inactive channel/Person still exists. Ensure no hidden recipient is linked. No clock or polling.
2. Lines 82 and 86 (error reducer halt and case propagation): use enabled real matching slack retrieval config and an Audience struct platform "unsupported_platform", sender = author_id, recipients = ["R_BAD"], which Audience.normalize accepts as nonblank evidence but PersonChannel.changeset rejects via @valid_platforms. Assert {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{} = cs} from resolve_audience; assert error on :platform/inclusion rather than generic :invalid_recipient_evidence; assert Repo shows no persisted Person/channel for R_BAD. This proves actual People.find_or_create_from_channel/2 error, reduce halt and unchanged case error. Optionally a first valid recipient cannot precede a bad one under a single platform, so do NOT claim cross-recipient transaction rollback: each lookup is independent. Avoid stubbing People.
3. Line 104 (non-Incoming fallback): assert {:error, :invalid_recipient_evidence} = resolve_audience(%{}, 1) and for nil/invalid non-Incoming as appropriate; this differs from an Incoming with mismatched config ID (line 101). No DB fixture.
4. Line 127 (invalid connector shape): resolve(incoming(%{routing_context: %RoutingContext{channel_config_id: 0}}), channels_router: RaiseRouter) yields {:error, :connector_mismatch}; also malformed negative/nonnumeric config IDs only if RoutingContext struct accepts them. No Person/Channel persisted and no fetch_profile/open_dm_channel (RaiseRouter). Do not use nil, which is explicitly allowed for author resolution.
5. Line 152 (stale scoped identity): reuse existing test/zaq/accounts/connector_person_discovery_test.exs fixture idea: create matching Mattermost retrieval ChannelConfig with URL "https://original.example.test", create Person with People.find_or_create_from_channel("mattermost", %{channel_id: "native", channel_config_id: config.id}); update same config URL to "https://changed.example.test" via changeset/Repo.update!, changing IdentityScope authority while keeping provider, retrieval kind, enabled and ID. Resolve Incoming provider :mattermost, author_id "native", routing_context ID = config.id with channels_router: RaiseRouter; assert exact {:error, :identity_scope_changed}, Person/channel ownership unchanged and no additional Person. This must stop before profile enrichment/slow discovery (RaiseRouter); assert underlying People.match_by_channel/3 returns the same scope error if useful. No direct schema tampering or disabled/archived config, which would exercise another branch.
6. Lines 234,245,305 feasibility gate: do not claim reachable coverage from fabricated success tuples. The fast path match_author/3 returns People.get_person_with_channels!/1 for the very channel ID and config, so find_channel normally locates it. Slow path People.find_or_create_from_channel/2 links the incoming ID atomically or returns an error. Blank/nil ID makes PersonChannel.changeset reject required channel_identifier before a successful slow path can call find_channel; the existing empty-author test confirms error. Existing tests deleting an email channel before resolve cause discovery to relink it, not reach nil. Thus find_channel/4 line 305, touch_channel/2 line 234, maybe_backfill_dm_channel/4 line 245 form one structurally unreachable chain for valid public inputs absent concurrent deletion/corrupt preload. Do not introduce production-only test hooks, mock internal People, race/sleep, or weaken the invariant just to count lines. If the implementation-phase audit finds a deterministic real public fixture, add an assertion that resolution remains {:ok, person} and no channel update/DM request occurs, with RaiseRouter for unwanted external calls; otherwise mark these three as unreachable/coverage exception in issue and PR and request owner review whether to remove dead defensive clauses in a separate approved production change. Do not alter production in this coverage issue.

Fixtures/isolation: real People, ChannelConfig, Repo and sandbox; unique identifier/email suffix per test; match provider, kind and enabled as required. Existing incoming/1 is sufficient except explicit Audience/RoutingContext. Do not mutate Application env or Mox global mode; retain async: true. Existing ErrorRouter/RaiseRouter only fake external Channels requests via injected channels_router and NodeRouter invocation; no new mock; use RaiseRouter only on cases that must return before external calls. If default Channels.Api path is used, existing NodeRouterMock expectations must match actual action/event, not silently swallow calls. Assert output and persisted ownership/status, not internal call counts alone; no sleeps or polling.

Property assessment: normalization and connector authority have broad safety inputs, but this issue targets fixed reachability branches, not a new invariant implementation. Prefer precise DB examples; optionally add a bounded StreamData property for invalid non-positive config IDs returning connector_mismatch without Person creation only if routing structs accept those values and runtime stays bounded, otherwise defer to existing connector-scope/property tests. No generated malformed audience values that bypass the specific reduction branch. Validation handoff for implementer (not run in this planning task): add tests first; run focused mix test test/zaq/people/identity_resolver_test.exs through Context Mode; inspect fresh per-line coverage for each reachable line (81,82,86,104,127,152), not just aggregate ratio; diagnose failures and rerun fresh coverage. Run mix q and isolated tests per docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md phase 4; review diff; reserve mix precommit for final human approval gate and coverage-upper handoff. Note any unreachable lines and fresh report evidence as exceptions in issue/PR. No application tests or Git changes during planning.

comments.text: Implemented reachable public-API regression scenarios in test/zaq/people/identity_resolver_test.exs: inactive audience recipient filtering with preserved channel, invalid recipient changeset propagation/reducer halt, non-Incoming evidence fallback, invalid connector rejection, and stale connector-scope identity rejection with ownership preserved. Serialized targeted command: mix test test/zaq/people/identity_resolver_test.exs — 20 tests, 0 failures (one transient initial failure corrected; retry passed). Per the plan feasibility gate, lines 234 (nil touch), 245 (nil backfill), and 305 (find_channel nil fallback) are structurally unreachable together for valid public inputs absent concurrent deletion/corrupt preload; no hooks/races/mocks added. Test run emits pre-existing unavailable :license_manager configuration warning.
